--- /dev/null
+++ b/models/marts/fct_producthunt_daily_semantic.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+version: 2
+semantic_models:
+- name: fct_producthunt_daily
+  description: 'Metric 5: Product Hunt activity per Pacific day (launches, launch-day comments), one row
+    per day per activity. Never add counts across activities.'
+  model: ref('fct_producthunt_daily')
+  defaults:
+    agg_time_dimension: launch_day
+  entities:
+  - name: producthunt_day
+    type: primary
+    expr: producthunt_day_key
+    config: &id001
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          null_rule: never
+  dimensions:
+  - name: launch_day
+    type: time
+    description: Pacific day (Product Hunt's day).
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+    config: *id001
+  - name: activity
+    type: categorical
+    description: launches or comments.
+    config: *id001
+  - name: activity_label
+    type: categorical
+    description: Launches or Comments.
+    config: *id001
+  - name: is_release_day
+    type: categorical
+    description: True on GTA 6's release day.
+    config: *id001
+  - name: days_from_release
+    type: categorical
+    description: Days after release day (negative before).
+    config: *id001
+  measures:
+  - name: producthunt_activity_count_measure
+    agg: sum
+    expr: activity_count
+    description: How many on the day.
+    config:
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          unit: count
+          additivity: additive
+          null_rule: NULL when unavailable, never zero.
+  - name: producthunt_activity_wow_pct_change
+    agg: max
+    expr: wow_pct_change
+    description: The day against the same weekday a week earlier, in percent.
+    config:
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          unit: percent
+          additivity: non_additive
+          null_rule: NULL unless both days have a count.
+  - name: producthunt_activity_prior_week_count
+    agg: max
+    expr: prior_week_count
+    description: The same weekday a week earlier.
+    config:
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          unit: count
+          additivity: non_additive
+          null_rule: NULL when that day has no count.

@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+version: 2
+semantic_models:
+- name: fct_producthunt_release_day_activities
+  description: 'Metric 5 breakdown: one row per activity, release day against the same weekday a week
+    before.'
+  model: ref('fct_producthunt_release_day_activities')
+  defaults:
+    agg_time_dimension: release_day
+  entities:
+  - name: producthunt_activity
+    type: primary
+    expr: activity
+    config: &id001
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          null_rule: never
+  dimensions:
+  - name: activity
+    type: categorical
+    description: launches or comments.
+    config: *id001
+  - name: activity_label
+    type: categorical
+    description: Launches or Comments.
+    config: *id001
+  - name: release_day
+    type: time
+    description: GTA 6's release day.
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+    config: *id001
+  - name: baseline_start
+    type: time
+    description: First baseline day.
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+    config: *id001
+  - name: baseline_end
+    type: time
+    description: Last baseline day.
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+    config: *id001
+  measures:
+  - name: producthunt_activity_pct_change
+    agg: max
+    expr: pct_change
+    description: Release day against the baseline, in percent.
+    config:
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          unit: percent
+          additivity: non_additive
+          null_rule: NULL unless release day and every baseline day have a count.
+  - name: producthunt_activity_release_day_count
+    agg: max
+    expr: release_day_count
+    description: Count on release day.
+    config:
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          unit: count
+          additivity: non_additive
+          null_rule: NULL until release day has ended and been counted.
+  - name: producthunt_activity_baseline_count
+    agg: max
+    expr: baseline_count
+    description: Count on the baseline day (median over baseline days).
+    config:
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          unit: count
+          additivity: non_additive
+          null_rule: NULL when no baseline day has a count.

@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+version: 2
+semantic_models:
+- name: fct_producthunt_release_day
+  description: 'Metric 5 headline: launches and launch-day comments on release day against the Thursday
+    before, one row per release day, with its breakdown.'
+  model: ref('fct_producthunt_release_day')
+  defaults:
+    agg_time_dimension: release_day
+  entities:
+  - name: producthunt_release_day
+    type: primary
+    expr: release_day_key
+    config: &id001
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          null_rule: never
+  dimensions:
+  - name: breakdown
+    type: categorical
+    description: Both activities' changes. Report it with the headline.
+    config: *id001
+  - name: release_day
+    type: time
+    description: GTA 6's release day.
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+    config: *id001
+  - name: baseline_start
+    type: time
+    description: First baseline day.
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+    config: *id001
+  - name: baseline_end
+    type: time
+    description: Last baseline day.
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+    config: *id001
+  measures:
+  - name: producthunt_launches_change_measure
+    agg: max
+    expr: producthunt_launches_change
+    description: Launches' release-day change, in percent.
+    config:
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          unit: percent
+          additivity: non_additive
+          null_rule: NULL until launches have a change.
+  - name: producthunt_comments_change_measure
+    agg: max
+    expr: producthunt_comments_change
+    description: Launch-day comments' release-day change, in percent.
+    config:
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          unit: percent
+          additivity: non_additive
+          null_rule: NULL until comments have a change.
